note: Basin hopping follows the AGOX basin-hopping example: a Metropolis sampler at 0.25 eV. The example rattles 3 atoms, the generator default, at amplitude 3 Å. This run rattles one quarter of the atoms at that amplitude, 9 atoms on LJ38. The archived geometry is quenched and seeded as the first sample. The seed is 314159 plus the start index. Local steps are SciPy L-BFGS-B, stopped when the maximum atomic force is 0.05 or after 500 steps. The example uses ASE BFGS and 5 steps, which does not resolve the 0.001 window. The potential is the harness Lennard-Jones potential, cutoff 40, epsilon 1, sigma 1, no shift. A success is an energy at or below the Cambridge LJ38 minimum on this potential plus 0.001. The force-call cap is 2000000.
